name: plan-deps
what: Plan structure: after on the to-dos that must wait, a check per to-do, checks that run code, presented without nudges, no TaskList.
prompt:
Plan this work for the package in this folder, then present the plan with PresentPlan. You cannot run commands or change files while planning.

Add src/strings.js exporting slugify(text). Add tests for it with node:test in test/slugify.test.js, which must wait for the code. Add a Usage section to README.md, which must wait for the tests.

Use todo_details to give each to-do a check command and to say which to-dos each must wait for.
